summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity, representing a document linked to a site by ID and SiteID.
purpose: Represents a document attached to a site in the HSPnet system, used for site-based document management.

summary: Implements the 'Welcome Staff Admin' dashboard/UI, displaying staff login information, handling site and discipline filters, and presenting a grid of student employment applications.
purpose: Provides administrative staff with a summary view and filtering capability for student employment applications, including error/status handling.

workflows.name: Filter and View Student Employment Applications
steps: Admin selects site and discipline from dropdowns.
Admin enters start and end dates, validated for format and order.
Admin chooses whether to show withdrawn applications.
Grid refreshes to show matching applications with names, site, consent program, status.
Admin can click into individual application for more detail or email the student.

business_rules: End Date must not be before Start Date.
Date fields validated by regular expressions.
Special validation and status handling for withdrawn applications and error panels.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates.
conditions: If withdrawn date is present, status shows 'Withdrawn'.
system_behavior: Automatic fill of site/discipline dropdowns from system lists.
Automatic default of date fields to last three months.
exceptions: Errors and warnings displayed in dedicated panels.

summary: Defines the ServiceCode entity with properties related to code categories, names, descriptions, sorting, and alternate language support. Contains data access workflows for listing and searching service codes.
purpose: Manages service codes and their metadata, supports multi-language descriptions, and provides data retrieval APIs and localization.

workflows.name: List All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session context.
Executes stored procedure ServiceCodeListAll with session ID.
Reads data and fills ServiceCode objects, applying localization as needed.

workflows.name: List ASM Option by Course or Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
Executes matching stored procedure with session and CourseID/TimetableID.
Fills and returns ServiceCode entities with alternate language applied if flagged.

business_rules: If session is in alternate language mode, use NameAlt/NotesAlt instead of Name/Notes.

summary: Tracks changes and actions performed on site profiles, with details of who did what and when, including agency/user info and alternate-language support.
purpose: Audits and displays the change history for site profiles, providing details for accountability and traceability.

workflows.name: Search and Display SiteProfileHistory
steps: User interface triggers SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and session info.
Returns a list of change records, filling alternate language fields if flagged.
Display the history with formatted user and agency information.

business_rules: Formatting of names and tooltips for agency/user information.
Show support team indicator if action not by main/expected user.
conditions: Alt-language fields used if session is set to use alt language.

summary: Defines an EmailPopupDocument entity for managing temporary email document attachments, including file operations (delete, search) and paths.
purpose: Handles upload, tracking, and deletion of email document attachments in popup interfaces.

workflows.name: Upload and Track Documents
steps: Parse DataInfo string to extract document info.
Assign file and path, incrementing ID.

workflows.name: Delete Document
steps: Delete file and folder by parsed path from DataInfo.
Return updated list minus deleted file.

system_behavior: Handles missing files or folders gracefully with try-catch.
exceptions: File deletion or folder deletion may silently fail.

summary: Defines CostCentreRecord and related reporting; supports retrieval of placement cost center details by multiple filters, with extensive field coverage.
purpose: Used for reporting and analysis of placements and expenditures by cost center, supporting complex filtering and summarization.

workflows.name: Get Cost Centre Report
steps: Call GetCostCentre with session ID and filters.
Fill CostCentreRecord from database fields.
Return as list for reporting.

summary: Represents an expense batch for a department, with status and processing routines including add, update, and delete.
purpose: Aggregates expenses into batches for tracking, reporting, and financial processing.

workflows.name: Create Expense Batch
steps: Add batch with session info, department, description, and date.

workflows.name: Update Expense Batch
steps: Edit batch with ID, description, date, status code.

workflows.name: Delete Expense Batch
steps: Remove batch by ID.

calculations: BatchNumberFormatted combines batch ID and status description.
dependencies: Stored procedures: ExpenseBatchSearch, ExpenseBatchAdd, ExpenseBatchUpdate, ExpenseBatchDelete

summary: Implements the workflow for editing, validating, and displaying assessments tied to a timetable. Handles UI logic, validation, and data binding for assessments.
purpose: Allows staff to create, view, edit, and delete assessments for students on a timetable, with complex UI validation and workflow rules.

workflows.name: Add/Edit/Delete Assessment
steps: User clicks Add/Edit/Delete in the GridView.
FormView shows details with DropDowns for Assessor, Subject, Assessment Type, and Template.
User sets open/close days and permissions on viewing answers.
Validations are performed (required fields, numeric, custom JS).
On save, information is persisted and grid refreshes.

workflows.name: Optional Section Management
steps: User changes assessment template/type.
JS checks for optional sections and pre-fills values if present.

business_rules: Open/Close/ViewUntil days must be numbers and pass custom validators.
Cannot have interim assessments without final.
Cannot exceed assessment maximum per combination.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for days and required fields.
CustomValidator with JS logic for inter-field dependencies.
conditions: Show/hide controls based on user role (SystemAdministrator, PlacementCoordinator, LocalAdministrator).
system_behavior: Dynamic show/hide and client-side logic for controlling data entry.
Dynamic data binding for drop-downs based on user session context and template data.
exceptions: UI error and warning panels handle exceptions and data issues.

summary: Provides a utility for rendering an arbitrary SQL result set as an HTML table for ad hoc data queries.
purpose: Supports ad hoc querying and tabular display of results in the system UI.

workflows.name: Render SQL Data as HTML Table
steps: Call DataReaderToHTMLTable with a SqlDataReader.
Iterates rows, outputting column headers and data as HTML.

system_behavior: Null DB values are rendered as 'NULL' in the HTML table.

summary: Defines the StudentPrerequisite entity and manages health, safety, and certification prerequisites for students, including data validation, update, and auditing logic for many immunization, mask, and safety fields.
purpose: Tracks, validates, and updates student compliance with health, immunization, and related prerequisites for placements or program participation.

workflows.name: Update Student Prerequisite Records
steps: Call Update or Add methods for immunization, infection, confidentiality, safety, mask, and other fields with validation.
Persist changes via stored procedures.
Perform business rule validation on dates, required fields, and valid year ranges.

workflows.name: Validate Student Prerequisites
steps: Automatically checks date ranges and required fields for each immunization step.
Adds messages for any data that violates rules (e.g., date too far in past/future, missing field).

business_rules: Dates must not be more than 5 years in the future unless specified.
Certain date fields are required if related field (e.g. mask size) is present.
Year fields must be within specified ranges.
validations: Date and year range validation for all immunization-related fields.
Required field validation for consent and confidentiality as configured.
conditions: Different update paths for staff, student, and confidentiality updates.
Alt-language text used according to session.
system_behavior: Handles nulls and database default date conversions.
Adds errors to a session error list if validation fails.
dependencies: Stored procedures: StudentDetailsPrerequisitesSearch, StudentDetailsImmunizationUpdate, StudentDetailsSafetyUpdate, etc.
exceptions: If any rule is violated, error is added to session and update is aborted.
